Example Girls Merit Scholarship

The Example Foundation supports school students who want to keep studying and go on to college.

Eligibility

The scholarship is open to girls studying in Class 10 at a recognised school anywhere in India.

Applicants must submit their latest mark sheet and a letter from their school principal.

Benefits

Selected students receive Rs. 12,000 per annum until they finish school.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload the documents listed above before the closing date.
